source.title: Forebears Guinea-Bissau forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized Portuguese/West African given names and surnames. This is not an official civil registry export.

source.title: ITU Guinea-Bissau national numbering plan communication of 29.X.2022

phones.notes: ITU/ARN confirms country code +245 and a closed nine-digit plan; public numbering data lists 95x, 96x and 977 mobile GSM ranges. Generated numbers are synthetic and not checked for live subscriber assignment or portability.

source.title: UPU General Addressing Issues: Guinea-Bissau postcode notes

locations.notes: UPU general material includes Guinea-Bissau in postcode discussions, while other public references conflict on formal postcode use. This dataset preserves simple four-digit-like generated values as synthetic review data and does not claim deliverability.

national_identity_card_number.label: National Identity Card

source.title: ID4Africa: Guinea-Bissau secure national ID case study

national_identity_card_number.notes: Public ID4Africa material confirms secure national ID card production/enrolment in Guinea-Bissau. No public official number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was found; generated values are synthetic placeholders.

passport.label: Passport
passport.notes: PRADO confirms Guinea-Bissau document coverage. No public passport-number grammar was confirmed; generation remains template-only synthetic.

driving_license_number.label: Driving Licence

source.title: PRADO Guinea-Bissau driving licence document entry

driving_license_number.notes: PRADO states the driving licence establishes identity within Guinea-Bissau territory but is not evidence of nationality. No public licence-number grammar was confirmed; generated values are synthetic placeholders.
